name: NRB Bearings Ltd
tagline: Established auto-bearings maker used in >90% of Indian vehicles, but slow ~5% growth, only ~13% ROE and ~58% of the promoter stake pledged - no catalyst and a real governance flag
business_overview: NRB Bearings is a long-established Indian manufacturer of needle roller and precision bearings for the automotive industry (2-wheelers, passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, tractors and aftermarket), with content in the large majority of vehicles made in India, plus a growing export book. The thesis pitch (per the thread title) is EV and exports driving the next leg of growth.
